name: mirage
text: Got it. Your second message came through as just 'Me', so send it again if it was cut off. On volume: from the 17 trades we could price, expected profit per trade is highest at a 2-4% margin (0% wins almost everything but earns nothing; 6%+ wins few). So 2% is already near the best, and lowering it would just give away edge. The limit is how many requests we can price at all, so that's what I'm widening (fair coverage fix + 10 min fair age are live). Next check: right after the engine's first scan, the share of requests priced and quotes won.
